description: Helps the person call a country with Suparelay: returns the landline and mobile prices per minute and a Call link that opens the Suparelay browser dialer. Use it when the person wants to call a country or asks what calls to it cost, without a phone number. Pass the two-letter ISO country code, such as IN. The person talks on the call in the browser; this tool does not dial.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

country.description: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, such as IN

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.
